name: Immunosuppressants: Calcineurin, Antimetabolites, Biologics and JAK

reference.source: KD Tripathi Essentials of Medical Pharmacology 8th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Calcineurin blockade silences IL2 transcription starving T cells while mTOR arrest stalls proliferation healing wounds poorly; TNF neutralisation unmasks latent granulomas reactivating TB, and B depletion erases HBV control flaring livers.
additionalDifferentials: Ciclosporin versus tacrolimus by cosmetic and diabetes
Sirolimus versus MMF by wounds and BK
Anti-TNF versus rituximab by TB and HBV
